identity.name: MaziyarPanahi/calme-3.1-baguette-3b
identity.summary: This model is a fine-tuned iteration of Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B, optimized for general-domain performance in French and English.

possible_risks.description: Determining who is responsible for an AI model is challenging without good documentation and governance processes. The use of synthetic data in model development adds further complexity, since the lack of standardized frameworks for recording synthetic data design choices and verification steps makes accountability harder to establish.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight fine-tune with license 'other' and no documentation of governance or evaluation details in the card

specifications.model_size: 5.7 GiB of safetensors weights (6,170,816,984 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: It is a fine-tuned iteration of Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B, adapted to improve general-domain performance in French and English.
training_context.training_data: The model was fine-tuned from Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B using two French instruction datasets: MaziyarPanahi/french_instruct_sharegpt and MaziyarPanahi/calme-legalkit-v0.2.
